sentences.text:
---
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH KUMAR ---

For the Petitioner(s)/Applicant(s) : Mr. I.S. Gupta, Adv.
 For the State : Mr. P.K. Mishra, A.P.P.
 ---
04/23.03.2023: Heard the parties.

The applicant, who is in custody since 08.09.2022, has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with S.T. No.281 of 2022 registered under Sections 323, 341, 376, 504, 506 and 34 IPC, pending in the court of Addl. Sessions Judge-II, Dumka.
The applicant is an accused of committing rape.
It has been submitted by the counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
Innocence has been claimed and participation in the trial has been assured.
It has been submitted that FIR has been lodged after delay of two months which itself falsifies the prosecution case.
On the above facts, prayer for bail has been made.
On the other hand, learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail and it has been submitted that the girl has supported the allegation in the statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
Considering the above facts, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant (s) on bail at this stage.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the applicant(s) stands rejected.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Ravi/-
